_status: FROZEN 2026-09-28 by explicit student approval (D-007). Do not change after results are observed.
_prohibition: Do not run alternative configurations and select a preferred one on performance. No prompt variants, no temperature sweep, no top-k sweep.

retrieval._top_k_rationale: Matches the @5 metric cutoff, ~1,700 token context, ~1.7% of the ~289 projected chunks.

generation._model_note: Fixed component of the RAG treatment, NOT an experimental variable. Verified available on the account API 2026-09-28.
generation._snapshot_note: No dated snapshot is published for this model; the alias is recorded as-is and every response is stored as a reproducibility artefact.
generation._seed_note: Set and recorded if the endpoint supports it. Recorded either way, including whether it was honoured.

citation_format._note: Validated against the retrieval log for that query. Retrieved-but-unsupporting = mis-citation; never-supplied = fabricated citation.

prompt._status: The seven REQUIREMENTS are frozen by approval. This text implements them.
frozen_requirements: grounding: answer only from supplied chunks, no outside knowledge
abstention: say so explicitly when the evidence is insufficient
citation on every claim, in a machine-checkable form
advisory framing: supports a human decision, does not make it
no autonomous action on the backlog

vector_store.name: chromadb
vector_store.numpy_cross_check: exact brute-force validation only; never used to alter, correct or tune results

layering.layer_a_retrieval_comparison: BM25 and RAG retrieval compared like-for-like over the same corpus, queries, ground truth and k=5.
layering.layer_b_user_facing: BM25 presents its top-5 retrieved passages; RAG presents this generated grounded answer. The two output forms are explicitly NOT identical. No prose answer is fabricated for BM25.
